cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: A compact planetarium lobby beside a bench made of dark glass and a miniature orbital map — She pauses on her way to the morning show and opens a little ticket envelope to check her seat; the long stone stairway of Baidicheng above the Yangtze gorge — holds a red oil-paper umbrella open over her shoulder; a themed costume event venue with props and a photo wall — holds her keepsake up beside her face; A public ferry pavilion with pale stone benches and a clear view of the harbour at golden hour — She pauses to watch projected sea charts before departure; a neon-lit game arcade — seated sideways on a stool or bench; a hydroponic garden dome aboard a starship — holds a sketchbook and pencil out at arm's length to look over the finished sketch; a moonlit lotus pond with stepping stones and glowing fireflies — chest-deep in the water; a medieval guild workshop — holds her keepsake up beside her face; the stone stairway up to an old city gate tower — holds a small hand lantern low at her side; a starship data archive — holds a book closed against her chest; an outdoor pool with lounge chairs and clear blue water — holds a cocktail glass by the stem at chest height; a chandelier ballroom at a masquerade — carries her keepsake low at her side; a club powder room with a lit mirror and neon on the tiles — standing
